ownerStatement: I approve Play Modes 0.2.1-experimental for release (fixes #764 and #810 through the issue-fix flow).
reason: Owner-requested fix of #764 (no USB package for 0.2.0) and #810 (modes leaking into a new project): Play Modes clears its table on ev_project_new only for PROJECT > NEW, not after CHANGE or RELOAD, and ships its first 0.2.x USB package. RAM trials on the owner's MKII (development base 3704e557) showed NEW clearing all 256 patterns to NORMAL, RELOAD restoring the saved modes and CHANGE loading the other project's modes, with no faults and 0 CPU points. Not run on a unit: a power cycle, an MKI, Keep, and STEP REPEAT by ear, so full current-build hardware qualification is waived. The 0.2.0 UI captures are retained: this change adds no page or control. This binds only this exact version and native source; hardware is not claimed verified.
